findings.reason: Real finite model-list probe verifies auth/model existence without redirects, retries, remote bodies or task uploads.
Dedicated sandbox credential entry and main-only encrypted storage bind keys to source and exact endpoint; no raw key enters the conversation/settings renderer.
Viewport constraints and positioned composer contain the hidden accessibility label; strict long-content and actual package scroll checks pass.
Initial-only form hydration preserves edits made immediately after saving; current form testing does not save it implicitly.
